## What's Changed

### New Features

- Added JSON and newline-delimited JSON support for external IP blocklists, including Spamhaus DROP v4 feeds.
- Added incremental log pagination: each action reveals the next 100 entries.

### Optimizations

- Preserve separately named manual allow/block lists and their entered IP/CIDR notation.
- Display GeoIP country information for manual and external protection events when MaxMind data is available.

### Bug Fixes

- Parse annotated text feeds such as Spamhaus DROP correctly.
- Keep manual IP lists intact when general settings are saved.
- Removed the stale persistent page-header status badge; action results use the confirmation popup.
